advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update or annotate `test_baseline_arbitration.py::test_summary_asymmetry_never_suppressed` (and its module docstring) to note it pins the production-dead adapter path, not live title arbitration, which now suppresses title per ADR 0026.

The new diff explicitly reverses this narrative for the live path: `outbound_field_diff.py:266` `--- title (inbound-mirrored per ADR 0026; local==baseline defers to inbound) ---`
advisory.finding: The existing unit test `test_summary_asymmetry_never_suppressed` and the module docstring in `test_baseline_arbitration.py` assert the exact OPPOSITE of the behavior this change introduces ("`summary` (local `title`) is NOT in `_INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS` ... a local title edit is ALWAYS emitted even when the local title == the baseline summary"). evidence: The adapter set contains `title` yet iterates Jira-shaped `summary` keys (per this diff's own commit message and outbound_fields.py:456 membership check), making its `title` entry effectively dead, unlike the core set.
advisory.finding: There are now two `_INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS` frozensets that both list `title` but behave oppositely: the adapter set (`outbound_fields.py:257`) is inert for title because that module iterates Jira-shaped keys where title is spelled `summary`, while the core set (`outbound_field_diff.py:46`) actively suppresses title because it iterates local-named keys. The duplicated-but-behaviorally-divergent constant is a maintenance hazard — a reader cannot tell from the sets alone which one gates title.
